english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the cost of something or an action.
Use this for the price of an item or service, rather than its wider expense or resource cost.

examples.english: The price of this shirt is a bit high.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 gaa3 cin4 jau5 di1 gou1

examples.english: The cost of this phone is quite reasonable.
examples.traditional: 呢部手機嘅價錢幾合理。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 gaa3 cin4 gei2 hap6 lei5
